originalTitle: The African fishermen who blame Chinese trawlers for their woes
title: Saving Our Fishy Friends!
content:
Hello from Sunny Sierra Leone!

Hi everyone! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, coming to you live from the beautiful continent of Africa! Today, we're going on a special adventure to a country called Sierra Leone. It's a lovely place with warm sunshine, friendly people, and a big, beautiful ocean!

Meet Our Fishing Friends!

In Sierra Leone, many wonderful people live near the sea. These people are called fishermen and fisherwomen. They are super important because they help feed their families and their communities. Every day, they wake up very early, sometimes even before the sun peeks out! They get into their small, colourful wooden boats, often powered by paddles or small motors. They go out onto the big blue ocean with their nets and lines. They work very hard to catch fish. The fish they catch are not just food; they are also a way for families to earn money. They sell some fish at the market so they can buy other important things, like school books, clothes, and yummy fruit. Imagine living by the sea and getting your food and your livelihood from it every day! It's a special way of life.

Did You Know?

Sierra Leone has a long, beautiful coastline! This means it has lots of beaches and places where the land meets the ocean. Fish is a very important food for the people here, and it's full of good things to help you grow strong and smart!

The Big Boats Arrive

Now, sometimes, something happens that makes our fishing friends a little sad. They see very, very big boats coming into their waters. These boats are called 'trawlers'. They are not small, colourful wooden boats like the local ones. Oh no! These trawlers are huge, like giant floating factories. They often come from far-away countries, like China. These big boats have super-long, super-strong nets. They are so big that they can catch a lot, a lot, a lot of fish all at once. Imagine a giant vacuum cleaner in the ocean, sucking up everything in its path! That's a bit like what these big trawlers do.

Taking Too Many Fish

Our local fishermen in Sierra Leone say that these big Chinese trawlers are taking too many fish. And sometimes, they are doing it in places where they are not allowed to fish! This is called 'illegal fishing'. It means they are breaking the rules of the ocean. When these big boats take so many fish, they leave very few for our local fishermen. Think about it: if there's a big cake, and one person eats almost all of it, what's left for everyone else? Not much, right? It's the same with the fish in the ocean. If the big trawlers 'hoover up' all the fish, then our local fishing friends find it very hard to catch anything.

Did You Know?

Fish lay eggs, and baby fish need safe places to grow big and strong! When too many fish are caught, especially the young ones, it means fewer fish will grow up to have more babies. This makes it hard for there to be enough fish for everyone in the future.

Why This Makes Fishermen Sad

This problem makes our fishing friends very worried and sad. When they go out to sea and can't find many fish, they come back with empty nets. No fish means no food for their families that day. No fish also means no money to buy other things they need. It's hard for parents to send their children to school if they don't have enough money. It's hard to put yummy and healthy food on the table. And it's also not good for the ocean and all the other amazing sea creatures that depend on these fish for their own food.

Did You Know?

The ocean is like a giant home for so many wonderful animals – not just fish, but also turtles, dolphins, whales, and more! When the balance of fish is upset, it can affect all these other amazing creatures too.

What Can We Do?

So, what can we do to help our fishing friends in Sierra Leone? People are talking about this problem. They are asking their leaders and the leaders of other countries to help. They want to make sure the rules about fishing are followed by everyone, big boats and small boats alike. They want to make sure that these big trawlers do not fish in places where they are not allowed, or take too many fish. It's important to protect our oceans. When we protect the fish, we help our fishing friends, we help families have food, and we help keep the ocean healthy for everyone. We can tell grown-ups about this problem and ask them to help protect our fishy friends!

Working Together for a Brighter Future!

Even though this is a big problem, there is hope! When people work together, they can make a difference. By caring for our oceans and making sure fishing rules are fair for everyone, we can help our fishing friends in Sierra Leone and ensure there are plenty of fish for generations to come. Let's all be ocean heroes! Thank you for listening, and remember to always care for our beautiful Earth and its amazing creatures!
summary: Local fishermen in Sierra Leone are sad because very big fishing boats from countries like China are catching too many fish, often in places they shouldn't, leaving little for the local communities.
whyMatters: This is important because when big boats take too many fish, local families don't have enough food or money, and it harms the ocean's health and all the animals living in it.

originalTitle: Nigeria says two nationals killed in South Africa amid rise of anti-migrant attacks
title: Being Kind to Our Neighbours: Sad News from Far Away
content:
Hello, Super Reporters!

Hi everyone! It's me, your kid-friendly news reporter for Africa! I'm here to share some news with you, and sometimes news can be a little bit sad. But it's important to know what's happening in our big, beautiful continent of Africa, so we can all learn to be kinder and help each other. Today, we're talking about something that happened between two countries in Africa: Nigeria and South Africa. They are both wonderful countries with lots of amazing people, animals, and stories. But sometimes, sad things happen, and it's good to talk about them so we can all learn and grow.

Sad News About Our Neighbours

Imagine you have a friend who lives far away. You might miss them, or you might hope they are happy and safe. Well, we have some sad news about some friends from Nigeria who were living in South Africa. Two people from Nigeria, who were like neighbours in our big African home, sadly passed away in South Africa. This makes us feel very sad, because we want all our friends and neighbours across Africa to be safe and happy, no matter where they live. Our hearts go out to their families and friends who are missing them very much. Did you know? Africa is a huge continent! It has 54 different countries, and each one is special. Nigeria and South Africa are two of those amazing countries!

What Happened to Our Friends?

We heard that one friend from Nigeria sadly died while he was with some police officers in South Africa. The news says that the police used very, very rough ways to ask him questions. These ways were so bad that our friend got very sick and, sadly, he passed away. Police officers are supposed to protect people and keep everyone safe, so this news makes us very sad and confused. It's like when your teacher asks you a question, they do it kindly, right? Police should also be kind and careful when they talk to people. We hope that grown-ups will find out exactly what happened and make sure that something like this never happens again. Did you know? Police officers wear special uniforms and often drive special cars to help people. Their main job is to keep everybody safe and help when there's a problem, like finding a lost pet or helping if someone gets hurt.

More Sad News

There was another friend from Nigeria who also sadly died in South Africa. The news tells us that this happened because some people in South Africa were not kind to people who came from other countries to live there. Sometimes, people can be unkind because they are scared or don't understand why people move from one country to another. When people move from one country to another to live, we call them 'migrants.' It's like moving to a new school or a new town. They might move to find a job, or to be with family, or to go to a better school, or just for an adventure! Everyone has a reason for moving, and we should always be kind and welcoming to new people, no matter where they come from. Did you know? Many people in Africa move from one country to another to find new opportunities, like a new job or a better place for their family to live. It's a bit like when birds fly to different places to find food or a warmer home!

Being Kind to Everyone

It's very important to remember that all people, no matter where they come from – Nigeria, South Africa, or any other country – deserve to be treated with kindness, respect, and love. Everyone is special, and everyone deserves to feel safe and happy in their home, even if that home is in a different country from where they were born. Imagine if you went to a new school. You would want new friends to smile at you and say hello, wouldn't you? It's the same for people who move to a new country. They hope for smiles and kindness. Did you know? The Golden Rule is to treat others how you want to be treated! If you want kindness, give kindness!

What Are Grown-Ups Doing?

The governments, which are like the big grown-ups in charge of countries, are talking about this sad news. The government of Nigeria is very sad and wants to know exactly what happened to their friends. They are talking to the government of South Africa to make sure that everyone from Nigeria who lives there is safe and treated well. They want to make sure that police officers always protect people and that everyone understands that being kind to people from other countries is very important. When governments talk, it's like when you talk to your friend to sort out a problem – you want to find a good solution so everyone can be happy again. Did you know? Governments are made up of many people who work together to make laws and keep a country running smoothly. They are like the big team leaders for a whole country!

What Can We Do?

Even though we are kids, we can do a lot! We can be kind to everyone we meet, whether they are from our street, our town, or a different country. We can learn about different countries in Africa and understand that we are all part of one big family. We can tell our grown-ups about being kind and fair. We can share our toys, help our friends, and always use kind words. Every little act of kindness helps make the world a better, safer, and happier place for everyone.

Let's Choose Kindness

So, remember, even when sad things happen, we can always choose to be kind. Let's hope that the governments work together to make sure everyone is safe and happy in Africa. And let's all do our part to spread kindness and friendship every single day. Because when we are kind, we make our world shine brighter! Thank you for listening, super reporters! See you next time with more news from our amazing continent!
summary: Two Nigerian people sadly died in South Africa, one while with police and another because some people were unkind to those from other countries, making governments and everyone hope for more kindness and safety across Africa.
whyMatters: This news is important because it reminds us that everyone, no matter where they come from, deserves to be treated kindly and kept safe, and that police should always protect people, not hurt them.

originalTitle: Thousands welcome home Cape Verde footballers after stunning World Cup run
title: Hooray! Cape Verde Football Heroes Get a Giant Welcome Home!
content:
Hello, Super Kids of Africa! Are you ready for some very exciting news? We have a wonderful story from a beautiful country called Cape Verde! It's about their amazing football team and how everyone celebrated them. Get ready to cheer!

A Sea of Blue for Our Heroes!

Imagine going to the airport, and it's not just a few people, but thousands and thousands! That's what happened in Cape Verde's biggest city, called Praia. People filled the streets and stood outside the airport. They were all wearing blue clothes, the colour of their country's football team! It looked like a giant, happy ocean of blue people! These people were there to say a very big "THANK YOU!" and "WELCOME HOME!" to their football heroes. The players had been away playing in a very important football competition. And guess what? They did SO well! Everyone was super proud.

Who Are the Blue Sharks?

Cape Verde has a very special football team. They are called the "Blue Sharks"! Isn't that a cool name? Sharks are strong and fast, just like their players. These Blue Sharks went to play in a big, big football competition. It felt like a World Cup journey for them, where teams from many places play together. **Did you know?** Football is also called soccer in some places! It's a game where two teams try to kick a ball into the other team's goal. It's super fun to play and watch! Our Blue Sharks played with all their heart. They ran fast, passed the ball well, and scored some amazing goals. They showed everyone how good they are. Even though they didn't win the very final prize, they played so well that it made their whole country jump with joy!

So Much Happiness and Pride!

When the Blue Sharks came home, the air was buzzing with excitement! People were waving flags, singing songs, and shouting happy cheers. They made loud noises with trumpets and drums. It was like the biggest party ever! Everyone wanted to see their heroes. Why were they so happy? Because the Blue Sharks showed everyone that even a small country can do amazing things. They played as a team, they never gave up, and they made everyone in Cape Verde feel incredibly proud. This feeling of pride makes people feel connected and happy together. **Did you know?** When a country's team does well in sports, it makes everyone feel like they are part of something special, like a big family!

Meet Our Football Stars!

The players stepped off their plane, and the crowd roared! They looked happy to be home and see all their fans. A fan is someone who really likes and supports a team or a person. These players are like real-life superheroes to many children in Cape Verde. They worked very hard, practiced every day, and gave their best. That's why they are heroes! They teach us that if you work hard and believe in yourself, you can achieve great things, no matter how big or small you are.

What is Cape Verde Like?

Let's learn a little bit about Cape Verde! It's not just one big piece of land. It's a country made up of many beautiful islands in the big ocean, off the coast of Africa. The sun shines bright, and there are lovely beaches. Praia is the capital city. A capital city is like the main city of a country, where important offices are. Imagine living on a beautiful island, surrounded by blue water! That's Cape Verde. **Did you know?** Islands are pieces of land that have water all around them! Cape Verde has ten main islands and many smaller ones.

Dream Big, Little Stars!

The welcome for the Blue Sharks was not just about football. It was about showing love and support. It was about dreaming big. It showed all the kids in Cape Verde, and all of Africa, that if you have a dream, you should work hard for it. Maybe some of you reading this will be the next football heroes! Or maybe you'll be great at something else, like being a doctor, a teacher, or an artist. Remember the Blue Sharks: play fair, work together, and always try your best. So, a big shout-out to the Blue Sharks of Cape Verde! You made everyone so proud. Keep shining, and keep inspiring us all to be the best we can be! What a super story from our amazing continent, Africa!
summary: Tens of thousands of happy fans in Cape Verde's capital, Praia, gave their national football team, the Blue Sharks, a hero's welcome home after they played wonderfully in a big football competition.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows how sports can bring a whole country together with happiness and pride, inspiring everyone, especially children, to work hard and dream big.

originalTitle: Which teams are in the World Cup quarterfinals, and what’s the schedule?
title: Our Big Football Dream: World Cup Quarterfinals Fun!
content:
Hello, Football Friends!

My name is Ama, and I'm your friendly news reporter from right here in Africa! I love sharing exciting stories with you, especially about things that make us all happy. And what makes us happier than football? The sound of the ball, the cheering crowds, the colourful jerseys – it’s all so wonderful! We know how much you love to kick a ball around with your friends after school, or watch the big games with your family. Well, imagine that, but with teams from *all* over the world! That’s what the FIFA World Cup is all about. It’s coming in 2026, and it’s going to be a super big event!

What is the World Cup?

The World Cup is like the biggest football party ever! Once every four years, the very best football teams from different countries come together to play. They want to find out which country has the absolute best team in the whole world. Think of it like a giant competition, but instead of just your school or village, it's every country! It brings people together, no matter where they are from. Everyone watches, cheers, and celebrates. It's truly amazing! Did you know? The World Cup trophy is called the FIFA World Cup Trophy, and it’s made of real gold! Only the winning team gets to hold it high in the air!

What Are Quarterfinals?

Now, let's talk about something called "quarterfinals." This sounds like a big word, but it's easy to understand. Imagine many, many teams start playing games. Slowly, the teams that don't play as well go home. The teams that play super well keep going! After many games, only 8 teams are left. These 8 teams play each other in what we call the "quarterfinals." It means they are super close to being the best, but they still have more games to win! Did you know? "Quarter" means one-fourth, or one out of four. So, quarterfinals means you are playing to get into the *last four* teams!

Our African Teams and the Dream!

Oh, how we love to see our African teams play in the World Cup! Teams from countries like Senegal, Morocco, Ghana, Nigeria, and Cameroon always work so hard to get there. They play with so much passion and skill! They make us all so proud. Imagine one of our African teams playing in the quarterfinals! That would be a huge celebration across our continent. We always cheer the loudest for them, hoping they can go all the way to the final. Their journey to the quarterfinals is long and hard, but full of heart! Did you know? Football is the most popular sport in Africa! Almost everyone loves to play or watch football here. It brings communities together.

How Do Teams Get There? (The Journey to Quarterfinals)

It's not easy for a team to get to the quarterfinals. First, they have to be one of the best teams in their own part of the world. Then, they play many more games against other strong teams to even get into the World Cup itself! Once they are in the World Cup, they play even more games. If they win enough games, they move on. If they keep winning, they finally make it to the exciting quarterfinals stage! It’s like climbing a very tall ladder, step by step, until you are near the top. Every game is important! Did you know? Teams train very, very hard for many years to get strong enough to play in the World Cup! They practice every day.

Where Do They Play? (Big Stadiums!)

For the FIFA World Cup 2026, the games will be played in faraway countries like the USA, Canada, and Mexico. These countries have very, very big stadiums. A stadium is like a giant arena, a special place with lots of seats where people can come to watch the football games. Some of these stadiums are so big, they can hold more than 80,000 people! Imagine all those people cheering at once – it would be so loud and exciting! Our favourite teams will play their important quarterfinal games in these huge stadiums. Did you know? The biggest football stadium in the world is called Rungrado 1st of May Stadium, and it can hold over 100,000 people! That's more people than live in some small towns!

When Do They Play? (Kick-off Times!)

When we talk about "kick-off times," it means the exact time when a football game starts. Because the games for the 2026 World Cup are happening very far away, the time in those countries will be different from the time here in Africa. So, some games might start very early in the morning for us, or maybe late at night! But that doesn’t stop us from watching, does it? We set our alarms, or we stay up late, wrapped in blankets, just to watch our favourite teams play their hearts out. It's all part of the excitement of the World Cup! Did you know? The world is divided into different "time zones." When it’s daytime in one country, it might be nighttime in another!

The Road to the Final!

After the quarterfinals, there are only 4 teams left. These teams play in what are called "semifinals." Then, the two winners from those games go on to play in the very, very last game – the big "Final"! That's where they decide who wins the World Cup trophy. Every single game, from the very first one to the final, is important. But the quarterfinals are a really big step, showing that a team is truly one of the best in the world. It’s a journey full of hope, skill, and amazing football moments! We will be watching and cheering every step of the way. Did you know? The World Cup Final is one of the most-watched events in the entire world! Billions of people tune in to see who will be crowned champions.

Why We Love the World Cup!

The World Cup is more than just football games. It’s about friendship, celebration, and dreams. It teaches us about teamwork, hard work, and never giving up. When we watch, we see countries coming together, even if they are far apart. We cheer for our teams, and we learn about other countries too. It’s a big, happy, global family party, and we are so excited for the FIFA World Cup 2026! Let’s keep practicing our own football skills, and dream of playing for our country one day!
summary: The FIFA World Cup 2026 is coming, and our African teams are dreaming of reaching the exciting quarterfinals stage, where only the best 8 teams play to get closer to the big trophy!
whyMatters: This matters because the World Cup is a super fun football party that brings all countries together, and it's a big dream for our African teams to play well and make us proud in the quarterfinals!

originalTitle: Bellingham inspires 10-man England to beat Mexico 3-2 in last-16 thriller
title: Wow! England Wins a Super Football Game Against Mexico!
content:
Hello from Africa, My Friends!

Hello, hello, my wonderful friends all across Africa! Your kid-friendly reporter is here with some super exciting news from the world of football! Guess what? There was a HUGE football game, and it was so much fun to watch!

It was a match between two very good teams: England and Mexico. And oh my goodness, what a game it was! England won! They beat Mexico by a score of 3 goals to 2 goals. Wow!

What is the World Cup?

This big game was part of something called the World Cup. The World Cup is like the biggest football party in the whole wide world! Teams from different countries play against each other to see who is the very best.

Imagine your school having a big sports day, but for whole countries! It happens every four years, and everyone gets so excited. Players work super hard to play in these games.

Meet the Brave Teams!

On one side, we had England. Their team is sometimes called the 'Three Lions' because they have lions on their shirt badge. They wear white shirts and they are very strong players.

On the other side, we had Mexico. Their team usually wears green shirts, and they are also very fast and skillful. Both teams wanted to win very, very much!

The Famous Stadium!

This big game was played in a super famous stadium called Estadio Azteca. This stadium is in Mexico, and it is HUGE! So many fans can fit inside to watch the game.

Imagine a place where thousands and thousands of people cheer and shout for their teams! That's Estadio Azteca. It's one of the most famous football grounds on Earth.

Did you know? Estadio Azteca has held the World Cup final game two times before! That's more than any other stadium in the world. It’s a very special place for football.

The Game Begins! Lots of Excitement!

When the whistle blew to start the game, everyone was so excited! The players ran fast, kicked the ball, and tried their best to score. The fans were cheering loudly, making a big, happy noise.

It was a 'last-16' game, which means it was like a knockout round. If you lose, you go home. If you win, you get to play another exciting game!

Goals, Goals, Goals!

England scored first! Everyone jumped up and cheered! Then Mexico scored, and their fans cheered just as loud. It went back and forth, like a super fun race.

In the end, England scored 3 goals, and Mexico scored 2 goals. So, England won 3-2! Every goal was special, and the players celebrated with big smiles.

Bellingham, the Hero!

One player who was super, super good for England was named Jude Bellingham. He played like a true hero! He ran everywhere, passed the ball well, and even scored a goal!

Bellingham helped his team a lot. He showed so much energy and bravery. He was like a shining star on the field, helping England push forward and win the game!

Did you know? Jude Bellingham is a very young player, but he plays like he has been playing football for a long, long time! He is a big inspiration for many kids who dream of playing football.

Playing with 10 Friends!

Something very difficult happened for England. One of their players had to leave the game early. This means England had to play with only 10 players on the field, while Mexico still had 11.

Imagine playing a game of tag, but one of your friends has to sit out. It makes it much harder! But England was so brave and worked even harder as a team. They didn't give up!

Even with one less player, England fought with all their heart. This made their win even more amazing and special! It shows how strong they are together.

Mexico Fought Hard! A First Time for Everything!

Mexico played so, so well too! They were strong and fast, and they scored two goals. Their fans were very proud of them, even though they lost.

This game was extra special because it was the very first time Mexico had ever lost a World Cup game at their home stadium, Estadio Azteca! Can you believe it? So, England made history!

Did you know? Every team tries their best to win, but sometimes, a loss can also teach them a lot. Mexico will learn from this and come back even stronger next time!

What Happens Next for England?

Because England won this game, they now get to go to the next round! It's called the 'quarterfinals.' This means they are getting closer and closer to the big World Cup final game!

They will play another game soon, hoping to win again and move on. Everyone will be cheering for them!

A Thrilling Game for Everyone!

This was one of those games that made everyone cheer and clap! It had lots of goals, lots of action, and lots of excitement. It was a true football thriller!

It shows us that football is a game of skill, teamwork, and never giving up, even when things get tough. Like when England played with 10 players!

Football Fun for Everyone!

So, there you have it, my friends! England won a very special game against Mexico, 3-2, making history at Estadio Azteca. It was all thanks to hard work, great goals, and a hero like Bellingham!

Football brings people together, makes us cheer, and teaches us about being part of a team. Keep playing, keep cheering, and keep loving the beautiful game! See you next time with more exciting news!
summary: England beat Mexico 3-2 in a very exciting World Cup football game, making history as it was Mexico's first loss at their home stadium, and England now goes to the next round.
whyMatters: This game was super important because England won a very tough match, even with one player less, and it was a big surprise for Mexico to lose at their special home stadium for the first time ever in the World Cup, bringing England closer to winning the big trophy.

originalTitle: Iran's supreme leader absent as senior officials attend ayatollah's funeral
title: Big News from Far Away: A Special Leader Misses a Funeral!
content:
Hello from Your Friendly Africa Reporter!

Hello, amazing kids! It's me, your friendly news reporter, bringing you special stories from all around the world. Today, we're going on an imaginary trip to a country called Iran. It's a land very far away from our beautiful Africa, across oceans and lands, but what happens there can still be interesting for us to learn about.

What is Iran?

Iran is a big country in a part of the world called the Middle East. It has ancient cities, beautiful carpets, and lovely stories. Just like our countries in Africa have important leaders, Iran has its own special leaders too. They help guide the country and its people. Did you know? Iran is home to some of the oldest civilisations in the world! People have lived there for thousands and thousands of years. Imagine how many stories the stones in their old cities could tell!

Who is the Supreme Leader?

In Iran, there is a very, very important person called the Supreme Leader. He is like a chief guide for the whole country. He helps make big decisions and also leads people in their religion. Think of him as someone with a very big and important job, like a president and a wise teacher all rolled into one. The current Supreme Leader of Iran is called Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Ayatollah is a special title for a very wise religious teacher. He has many responsibilities to look after his country.

A Sad Day and a Missing Leader

Sometimes, sad things happen in the world, like when an important person passes away. Recently, there was a funeral in Iran. A funeral is a special ceremony where people say goodbye to someone who has died. This funeral was for another important religious teacher, an 'Ayatollah'. Many important people went to this funeral to show their respect. But guess what? The Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was not there. He was absent. This made some people wonder why such a very important leader was not present at such an important event. It's like if your school principal missed a very big school assembly. People might ask, 'Where is the principal?' Did you know? In many cultures around the world, including some in Africa, funerals are very important events. They are a time for family and community to come together to remember and honour the person who has passed away.

Who is Mojtaba?

Now, the Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has a son. His name is Mojtaba Khamenei. He is also an important person in Iran. People usually see him at public events or when he is with his father. But lately, Mojtaba has not been seen by anyone in public. It's like if your favourite football player suddenly didn't come to play in any matches, and no one saw him anywhere. You would wonder what happened and why he wasn't around.

A Time of Big Worries

So, why has Mojtaba not been seen? Well, the news tells us that Mojtaba has not been out in public since a very sad and serious time. This was when there was a lot of worry and big disagreements between countries. Some big countries, like the United States (USA) and Israel, were having very serious problems with Iran. When countries have big disagreements, sometimes they are called a 'war' or a 'conflict'. It means there is a lot of tension and sometimes even fighting. During such times, things can be dangerous. People might need to stay safe and out of harm's way. Did you know? When countries have problems, they often try to talk about them first. Talking is a good way to solve disagreements without fighting. It's just like when you and your friend have a disagreement – it's always best to talk it out and find a solution together!

Wishing for Peace

Because of these big problems and worries, it seems Mojtaba has been staying out of public view. It's a serious situation, and sometimes people need to be careful during such times. So, the Supreme Leader was not at the funeral, and his son, Mojtaba, has not been seen for a while, all linked to this period of big worries. It reminds us that even far away, leaders have very important jobs, and sometimes their lives can be complicated by big world events. We always hope for peace in the world, so that everyone, everywhere, can feel safe and happy, and leaders can attend important events without worry. Let's all remember to be kind to each other and always try to solve our problems with talking and understanding. That way, we can all help make our big world a safer and happier place for everyone, from Africa to Iran and everywhere in between! Thank you for listening, little reporters! Until next time, stay curious and kind!
summary: Iran's important Supreme Leader missed a religious leader's funeral, and his son, Mojtaba, has not been seen in public recently because of a time of big worries and disagreements between countries.
whyMatters: This news is important because it shows that even very important leaders can have complicated situations, especially when countries are having big disagreements, reminding us how much we wish for peace and safety everywhere.
